definitions.name: SQL Server Parameterized Query
definitions.description: SQL Server Parameterized Query
definitions.documentation: Parameterized Query. Requires native tedious@20.3.8 installed as a production dependency in the trusted ONF worker image. No job-time installation, bundled-driver workaround or HTTP replacement. Worker/image provisioning is an operator prerequisite. Uses real Tedious Connection/Request/parameter/transaction API, not HTTP. Explicit TCP server/database/SQL username/password or encrypted connectionStringSecret with conservative ADO.NET SQL-auth fields; Persist Security Info/PersistSecurityInfo=false/no is accepted and ignored without persisting or returning connection strings; true/yes and invalid values are rejected; explicit node settings and passwordSecret override string fields. Encryption disable/certificate trust bypass are rejected; caSecret/serverName provide explicit verified private-root/identity overrides. Verified TLS 1.2+ required, no ambient credentials, instance discovery, NTLM/Azure identity/custom endpoints/pools/bulk or stored-procedure calls exposed. RuntimeConnection uses profile.config and credentials.username/password; config.$connection selects it. SQL/mutations require confirm=true; all retries=0. Bounds: 512KiB input,64KiB SQL,1000 explicit typed params,50 statements,10000 rows/1MiB complete output,60s maximum deadline,250ms cleanup. One serial transaction; returned shape and size validated before commit. Conservative unsupported SQL-feature checks are not a security sandbox; database privileges and TLS remain authoritative. The full native driver/dependency graph runs within the trusted worker boundary with filesystem capability; these permissions are disclosure, not a module or filesystem sandbox. Synthetic native TLS/TDS validates login, transactions, request parsing, rejection and cleanup; real database compatibility remains unverified. Duplicate raw column names preserve ordered fields/values; known catalogs use explicit named resources. BigInt strings/binary hex retained, Tedious decimal/money numbers and Date conversion may lose precision; cast exact values to nvarchar in SQL. No real DB or app state tested. Sources: https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-connection.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-request.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/parameters.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-datatypes.html https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/system-catalog-views/catalog-views-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17 https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/language-elements/begin-transaction-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17

passwordSecret.description: Optional password override; defaults internally to SQLSERVER_PASSWORD when no connection string/profile password is selected.

connectionStringSecret.description: Encrypted ADO.NET SQL-auth TCP connection string. Verified TLS required; explicit node connection settings override string fields.

definitions.name: SQL Server Update Matching Rows
definitions.description: SQL Server Update Matching Rows
definitions.documentation: Update Matching Rows. Requires native tedious@20.3.8 installed as a production dependency in the trusted ONF worker image. No job-time installation, bundled-driver workaround or HTTP replacement. Worker/image provisioning is an operator prerequisite. Uses real Tedious Connection/Request/parameter/transaction API, not HTTP. Explicit TCP server/database/SQL username/password or encrypted connectionStringSecret with conservative ADO.NET SQL-auth fields; Persist Security Info/PersistSecurityInfo=false/no is accepted and ignored without persisting or returning connection strings; true/yes and invalid values are rejected; explicit node settings and passwordSecret override string fields. Encryption disable/certificate trust bypass are rejected; caSecret/serverName provide explicit verified private-root/identity overrides. Verified TLS 1.2+ required, no ambient credentials, instance discovery, NTLM/Azure identity/custom endpoints/pools/bulk or stored-procedure calls exposed. RuntimeConnection uses profile.config and credentials.username/password; config.$connection selects it. SQL/mutations require confirm=true; all retries=0. Bounds: 512KiB input,64KiB SQL,1000 explicit typed params,50 statements,10000 rows/1MiB complete output,60s maximum deadline,250ms cleanup. One serial transaction; returned shape and size validated before commit. Conservative unsupported SQL-feature checks are not a security sandbox; database privileges and TLS remain authoritative. The full native driver/dependency graph runs within the trusted worker boundary with filesystem capability; these permissions are disclosure, not a module or filesystem sandbox. Synthetic native TLS/TDS validates login, transactions, request parsing, rejection and cleanup; real database compatibility remains unverified. definitions.documentation: Schema List. Requires native tedious@20.3.8 installed as a production dependency in the trusted ONF worker image. No job-time installation, bundled-driver workaround or HTTP replacement. Worker/image provisioning is an operator prerequisite. Uses real Tedious Connection/Request/parameter/transaction API, not HTTP. Explicit TCP server/database/SQL username/password or encrypted connectionStringSecret with conservative ADO.NET SQL-auth fields; Persist Security Info/PersistSecurityInfo=false/no is accepted and ignored without persisting or returning connection strings; true/yes and invalid values are rejected; explicit node settings and passwordSecret override string fields. Encryption disable/certificate trust bypass are rejected; caSecret/serverName provide explicit verified private-root/identity overrides. Verified TLS 1.2+ required, no ambient credentials, instance discovery, NTLM/Azure identity/custom endpoints/pools/bulk or stored-procedure calls exposed. RuntimeConnection uses profile.config and credentials.username/password; config.$connection selects it. SQL/mutations require confirm=true; all retries=0. Bounds: 512KiB input,64KiB SQL,1000 explicit typed params,50 statements,10000 rows/1MiB complete output,60s maximum deadline,250ms cleanup. One serial transaction; returned shape and size validated before commit. Conservative unsupported SQL-feature checks are not a security sandbox; database privileges and TLS remain authoritative. definitions.name: SQL Server Default Constraint List
definitions.description: SQL Server Default Constraint List
definitions.documentation: Default Constraint List. Requires native tedious@20.3.8 installed as a production dependency in the trusted ONF worker image. No job-time installation, bundled-driver workaround or HTTP replacement. Worker/image provisioning is an operator prerequisite. Uses real Tedious Connection/Request/parameter/transaction API, not HTTP. Explicit TCP server/database/SQL username/password or encrypted connectionStringSecret with conservative ADO.NET SQL-auth fields; Persist Security Info/PersistSecurityInfo=false/no is accepted and ignored without persisting or returning connection strings; true/yes and invalid values are rejected; explicit node settings and passwordSecret override string fields. Encryption disable/certificate trust bypass are rejected; caSecret/serverName provide explicit verified private-root/identity overrides. Verified TLS 1.2+ required, no ambient credentials, instance discovery, NTLM/Azure identity/custom endpoints/pools/bulk or stored-procedure calls exposed. RuntimeConnection uses profile.config and credentials.username/password; config.$connection selects it. SQL/mutations require confirm=true; all retries=0. Bounds: 512KiB input,64KiB SQL,1000 explicit typed params,50 statements,10000 rows/1MiB complete output,60s maximum deadline,250ms cleanup. One serial transaction; returned shape and size validated before commit. Conservative unsupported SQL-feature checks are not a security sandbox; database privileges and TLS remain authoritative. The full native driver/dependency graph runs within the trusted worker boundary with filesystem capability; these permissions are disclosure, not a module or filesystem sandbox. Synthetic native TLS/TDS validates login, transactions, request parsing, rejection and cleanup; real database compatibility remains unverified. Duplicate raw column names preserve ordered fields/values; known catalogs use explicit named resources. BigInt strings/binary hex retained, Tedious decimal/money numbers and Date conversion may lose precision; cast exact values to nvarchar in SQL. No real DB or app state tested. definitions.name: SQL Server Statistic List
definitions.description: SQL Server Statistic List
definitions.documentation: Statistic List. Requires native tedious@20.3.8 installed as a production dependency in the trusted ONF worker image. No job-time installation, bundled-driver workaround or HTTP replacement. Worker/image provisioning is an operator prerequisite. Uses real Tedious Connection/Request/parameter/transaction API, not HTTP. Explicit TCP server/database/SQL username/password or encrypted connectionStringSecret with conservative ADO.NET SQL-auth fields; Persist Security Info/PersistSecurityInfo=false/no is accepted and ignored without persisting or returning connection strings; true/yes and invalid values are rejected; explicit node settings and passwordSecret override string fields. Encryption disable/certificate trust bypass are rejected; caSecret/serverName provide explicit verified private-root/identity overrides. Verified TLS 1.2+ required, no ambient credentials, instance discovery, NTLM/Azure identity/custom endpoints/pools/bulk or stored-procedure calls exposed. RuntimeConnection uses profile.config and credentials.username/password; config.$connection selects it. SQL/mutations require confirm=true; all retries=0. Bounds: 512KiB input,64KiB SQL,1000 explicit typed params,50 statements,10000 rows/1MiB complete output,60s maximum deadline,250ms cleanup. One serial transaction; returned shape and size validated before commit. Conservative unsupported SQL-feature checks are not a security sandbox; database privileges and TLS remain authoritative. The full native driver/dependency graph runs within the trusted worker boundary with filesystem capability; these permissions are disclosure, not a module or filesystem sandbox. Synthetic native TLS/TDS validates login, transactions, request parsing, rejection and cleanup; real database compatibility remains unverified. Duplicate raw column names preserve ordered fields/values; known catalogs use explicit named resources. BigInt strings/binary hex retained, Tedious decimal/money numbers and Date conversion may lose precision; cast exact values to nvarchar in SQL. No real DB or app state tested. Sources: https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-connection.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-request.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/parameters.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-datatypes.html https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/system-catalog-views/catalog-views-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17 https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/language-elements/begin-transaction-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17

definitions.description: SQL Server Collation List
definitions.documentation: Collation List. Requires native tedious@20.3.8 installed as a production dependency in the trusted ONF worker image. No job-time installation, bundled-driver workaround or HTTP replacement. Worker/image provisioning is an operator prerequisite. Uses real Tedious Connection/Request/parameter/transaction API, not HTTP. Explicit TCP server/database/SQL username/password or encrypted connectionStringSecret with conservative ADO.NET SQL-auth fields; Persist Security Info/PersistSecurityInfo=false/no is accepted and ignored without persisting or returning connection strings; true/yes and invalid values are rejected; explicit node settings and passwordSecret override string fields. Encryption disable/certificate trust bypass are rejected; caSecret/serverName provide explicit verified private-root/identity overrides. Verified TLS 1.2+ required, no ambient credentials, instance discovery, NTLM/Azure identity/custom endpoints/pools/bulk or stored-procedure calls exposed. RuntimeConnection uses profile.config and credentials.username/password; config.$connection selects it. SQL/mutations require confirm=true; all retries=0. Bounds: 512KiB input,64KiB SQL,1000 explicit typed params,50 statements,10000 rows/1MiB complete output,60s maximum deadline,250ms cleanup. One serial transaction; returned shape and size validated before commit. Conservative unsupported SQL-feature checks are not a security sandbox; database privileges and TLS remain authoritative. The full native driver/dependency graph runs within the trusted worker boundary with filesystem capability; these permissions are disclosure, not a module or filesystem sandbox. Synthetic native TLS/TDS validates login, transactions, request parsing, rejection and cleanup; real database compatibility remains unverified. Duplicate raw column names preserve ordered fields/values; known catalogs use explicit named resources. BigInt strings/binary hex retained, Tedious decimal/money numbers and Date conversion may lose precision; cast exact values to nvarchar in SQL. No real DB or app state tested. Sources: https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-connection.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-request.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/parameters.html https://tediousjs.github.io/tedious/api-datatypes.html https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/system-catalog-views/catalog-views-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17 https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/language-elements/begin-transaction-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17
